description: The industry the spot usage belongs to. With usage it is the row's key.
The spot usage, as spot_assignments.csv's Usage names it. A usage with no row here gets the generic loads waybill_deck.waybill_spec builds from its name.
The load the cards carry in: a commodity, a group (Process Chemicals, General Freight) whose parties name the per-card load, or EMPTY for a load spot.
The load the cards carry out: a commodity, General Freight, or EMPTY for an unload spot.
